name: adaptive-learning-course
title_zh: 先摸底再开课，每节课都按你刚答错的题生成
tagline_zh: 不是又一套录播课。它先跟你聊背景、做诊断，你点头才定计划；每节课后按你答错的题出练习，批改用对话完成。
tagline_en: Not another video library. It interviews you, runs diagnostics, gets your sign-off on the plan, then generates.
desc_en: Design and run personalized learning programs through background interviews, tailored diagnostics, user-approved course plans, on-demand lessons, saved exercises, and conversational grading. Use when a user asks to learn a subject systematically, assess their level, create a course, or continue an existing adaptive course.
why_zh: 课程计划不是模板套用，而是诊断结果加你的确认；练习和批改闭环在对话里，学没学会当场可见。
why_en: The syllabus is derived from your diagnostics plus your explicit approval, not a template. Practice and grading close the loop.
limit_zh: 只覆盖语言、数学等可客观出题的知识域；不生成视频或音频，产物是文字讲义与练习；需要你持续对话配合，不能静默自学。
limit_en: Only for objectively gradable domains (language, math). Outputs text lessons and exercises, no audio/video. Requires ongoing dialogue; cannot run.
title_en: Diagnose first, then build a course that adapts to each.
